collection_note: Workflow run metrics cover the full 24-hour window. Logs expose safe-output tool-call activity only as per-batch aggregates, without workflow attribution or outcome reports; GitHub issue search filtered one result under the integrity policy, and the available GitHub tools do not expose discussion replies or issue reactions. Per-workflow safe-output, engagement, and quality measures are null where runs were present; ecosystem safe-output activity is retained as tool-call counts, not confirmed accepted outputs.
